import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Stress Level', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='BMI Category', size='Physical Activity Level', 
                alpha=0.7, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Stress vs Sleep Quality by BMI Category (Size: Physical Activity Level)')
plt.xlabel('Stress Level')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
